q: A buyer asks whether we have an emissions reduction target. What should a small supplier say?
title: Supplier reduction target for a buyer
short: Answer honestly. If you have no target, say so and give your measured baseline and the steps planned. If you set one, keep it simple, absolute or per unit, with a base year and target year. A science-based target is optional for most small suppliers.
audience: MSME suppliers asked about targets by larger customers

ul: Share the baseline year and figure.
List planned actions: solar, efficient motors, fuel switch.
Give a date to set a target.

p: Choose absolute or intensity, a base year with real data, and a target year. Track it each year.
SBTi has a simpler route for small companies; check whether the buyer actually requires it.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.
